# Global Wood Density Database v2.2 attribution

The files `gwddagg_v2.2_species.csv.gz`, `gwddagg_v2.2_binomial.csv.gz`, and
`gwddagg_v2.2_genus.csv.gz` are gzip-compressed copies of the corresponding
GWDD v2.2 CSV files. Their tabular contents are redistributed without
modification under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence
(CC BY 4.0).

Source: Fischer, F. J., Chave, J., Zanne, A., Jucker, T., Fajardo, A.,
Fayolle, A., Ferreira de Lima, R. A., et al. (2026). Global Wood Density
Database v2.2. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18262736

Associated article: Fischer, F. J., et al. (2026). Beyond species means—the
intraspecific contribution to global wood density variation. New Phytologist,
249, 2630–2651. https://doi.org/10.1111/nph.70860

Licence: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The `chave_biomass()` lookup uses the model-derived trunk estimate
`wsg_est_trunk`. It does not use `wsg_raw`.

Official MD5 checksums before gzip compression:

- `gwddagg_v2.2_species.csv`: `a8f0317b62e9412df00bffc329015c89`
- `gwddagg_v2.2_binomial.csv`: `2ce721e791fca2b5eb17c31f81a59228`
- `gwddagg_v2.2_genus.csv`: `f9e7ccb930ffa22a433ec2f19af035bb`
